horoscopes.title: Aries Weekly Horoscope Starting September 20
content: For individuals with Aries Sun, Moon, or rising placements, family matters will be a primary focus as Mars transits the concluding degrees of Cancer. Activities related to land purchases, property sales, construction, renovation, or relocation are expected to reach their final stages. Important decisions concerning the household, parents, ancestral property, or living arrangements will need to be made. Vehicle-related matters, including purchase, replacement, repairs, insurance, or documentation, will also require attention. For those involved in agriculture, increased activity connected with land, farming, machinery, or cultivation is anticipated. Family meetings and enhanced communication with maternal figures are also indicated.

This week, the sun's shift into Libra places significant focus on your relationships. Your interactions with others will hold considerable importance. This period will illuminate areas within your relationships that require attention, offering an opportune moment to address and resolve any existing concerns. New contracts and agreements may be presented, making it essential to review all documentation thoroughly. For those whose work involves clients, customers, consulting, or public engagement, an increase in activity can be expected. New contacts may approach you with proposals for collaboration or business. Additionally, current agreements may be brought forward for reassessment.

Financial matters will take precedence. You will review documents and manage pending payments, settlements, or repayment plans. Decisions concerning loan applications or existing debts are likely. Discussions may encompass funds from insurance, gratuities, pensions, compensation, or inheritances. A partner's financial situation could change, prompting adjustments to shared expenses. Paperwork for wills, nominations, property shares, and financial agreements will require focus. Be prepared for some sudden expenses.

horoscopes.title: Taurus Weekly Horoscope Starting September 20
content: For Taurus Sun, Moon and rising signs, Mars is moving through the last degrees of Cancer, so the third house will be quite active. You will have more phone calls, messages, meetings, and short trips during this week. Work-related travel or repeated visits to nearby places will also come up. Siblings will have some important developments, and you will be involved in their matters. Those working in writing, media, marketing, sales, teaching, or online business will have a busy schedule. Documents, applications, and paperwork will need quick action. Since Mars is debilitated, there will be technical glitches, so this is not the time to buy a new electronic device.

Your work responsibilities will increase as the Sun will move into Libra. Some issues with colleagues or employees will need to be sorted out. Job seekers will get opportunities to attend interviews or follow up on earlier applications. Loans, EMIs, bills, and other repayments will also come up. There will be competitive events like sports, interviews and competitive projects too. The Sun debilitation in the sixth house will also bring some health issues, so you need to take up medication, this will be just temporary.

Next important transit will be Mercury moving into Scorpio, which will conjunct Venus, so marriage, family plans, money, and responsibilities will be the core theme. Unmarried people will receive proposals or start discussing a relationship more seriously. Business owners will have meetings with partners, clients, and potential collaborators. New contracts and agreements will come up, and some existing agreements will need changes. Both Venus and Mercury are natural malefics, so they both will bring new business partners too. Venus in the seventh house will also bring social invitations and opportunities to meet new people through work, business, or personal connections.

horoscopes.title: Gemini Weekly Horoscope Starting September 20
content: For Gemini Sun, Moon and rising signs, money and family matters will become important as Mars moves through the last degrees of Cancer. You will have to deal with household expenses, payments, savings, and purchases that have been waiting for some time. A family discussion about money or property will also come up. Some of you will spend on valuables, food, family functions, or household requirements. There will be changes in the way you handle your savings. Mars is debilitated in the second house, so expenses will increase, and arguments within the family can happen because of money or the way something is communicated.

The Sun will enter Libra, its debilitation sign, and the fifth house will become active. Children will need more attention because of their education, examinations, admissions, or other important developments. Those trying for higher studies will have applications, interviews, or course-related decisions. A new romantic relationship will start for some, while existing couples will discuss where the relationship is heading. Creative projects will also move forward, especially for people working in media, entertainment, writing, design, or teaching. Speculative investments and other risky financial decisions will come up, but there will be fluctuations in these matters.

Mercury will enter Scorpio, where Venus is already placed, so work and daily responsibilities will increase. Both Venus and Mercury are planets for networking, so there will be more communication at work. You can expect new job opportunities to some job calls, so prepare yourself for that. Competition at work will increase, and disagreements with co-workers or employees will need attention. Loans, credit cards, EMIs, and pending bills will require proper handling. Those dealing with court cases, complaints, or disputes will receive further communication. Health matters will also come into focus through check-ups, medical tests, medicines, or treatment. You will also have more responsibilities connected with pets or their health.

horoscopes.title: Cancer Weekly Horoscope Starting September 20
content: For Cancer Sun, Moon and rising signs, Mars is moving through the last degrees of your sign, so this week will keep you busy with your own plans and responsibilities. You will take some decisions without waiting for others, especially in matters that have already been delayed. Mars is debilitated here, so there are chances for getting minor health issues including injuries. You will have new plans even for your refinement, . Mars is debilitated in Cancer, so arguments will come up easily, particularly when someone questions your decisions. This Mars also can bring fake projects, so make sure you don’t fall into such traps.

The Sun will enter Libra, its debilitation sign, so home and family matters will need attention. A property deal, house search, renovation, repair, or relocation plan will move forward. Some of you will have discussions about buying or selling land. Vehicle matters will come up through servicing, repairs, insurance, documentation, or a new purchase. Elders in the family will need more support, but you may not be aware of that. Household expenses will increase because of repairs, furniture, appliances, or other necessities. Students will have developments regarding admissions, courses, examinations, or a change in their place of study.

Mercury will enter Scorpio, where Venus is already placed, and children, romance, education, and creative work will become important. Parents will be busy with their children’s studies, admissions, competitions, or other activities. Those planning for pregnancy will have consultations or related discussions. A romantic relationship will become more active through meetings and regular communication. Some of you will meet someone new or take an existing relationship forward. Students will be busy with applications, projects, examinations, and course decisions. Writers, teachers, designers, artists, and people working in entertainment will get new assignments. Investments, trading, and speculative matters will also bring transactions, discussions, and financial decisions.

horoscopes.title: Leo Weekly Horoscope Starting September 20
content: For Leo Sun, Moon and rising signs, Mars is moving through the last degrees of Cancer, so expenses will be one of the main concerns this week. There will be multiple expenses connected to travel, and healing matters. Some of you will travel to a distant place or make arrangements for an upcoming journey. Work connected with foreign countries or people living abroad will also become active. Those waiting for visas, immigration papers, or overseas opportunities will receive further updates. Sleep will be disturbed because of a busy schedule. Mars is debilitated in the twelfth house, so hospital visits, medical expenses, and unexpected spending will also come up.

The Sun will enter Libra, its debilitation sign, and the third house will become active. Get ready to communicate with a lot of people, and work in communication based projects. You will have important conversations with siblings, and their personal or professional matters will require your involvement. Some of you will buy a phone, laptop, vehicle, or equipment needed for work. Applications, documents, licences, and other paperwork will move forward. Those working in writing, media, marketing, sales, teaching, or online platforms will have a busier schedule. Differences with siblings or neighbours will also need to be sorted out.

Mercury will enter Scorpio, where Venus is already placed, bringing attention to joint finances and money shared with other people. You will discuss loans, taxes, insurance, inheritance, investments, or your partner’s finances. Some of you will apply for a loan, restructure an existing debt, or complete pending financial paperwork. Insurance claims, settlements, compensation, gratuity, pension, or inheritance matters will bring further communication. Your spouse’s income or expenses will require some adjustments in the family budget. Matters involving wills, nominations, property shares, and family assets will also come up. Sudden expenses will require you to rearrange some financial plans.

horoscopes.title: Virgo Weekly Horoscope Starting September 20
content: For Virgo Sun, Moon and rising signs, Mars is moving through the last degrees of Cancer, so the eleventh house will bring more activity through income, friends, professional contacts, and group projects. Money that has been delayed will reach some of you, especially through salary dues, incentives, commissions, or business payments. You will meet people who can connect you with a new project or work opportunity. Friends will have important developments, and you will become involved in their plans. Team activities and professional networks will keep you busy. Mars is debilitated here, so disagreements within a team or friendship can also come up, particularly over money or responsibilities.

One of the main transits will be Sun entering Libra, and it will be debilitated for next thirty plus days. You will have discussions about salary, savings, household expenses, and family responsibilities. A major purchase will require some rearrangement of your budget. Family members will also sit together to discuss money, property, or an upcoming expense. Some of you will buy jewellery, valuables, or items needed for the household. Income-related discussions will come up at work as well. Since the Sun is debilitated so, there will be heated arguments with everyone around you. It will be good if you control yourself in sensitive times.

The transit Mercury will enter Scorpio, which will conjunct Venus, so, this is the time to multitask. You will communicate frequently with siblings, cousins, neighbours, and people connected with your daily work. A sibling will have an important event or decision, and you will be involved in it. Writing, teaching, marketing, sales, media, publishing, and online work will become busier. Some of you will start a new course or training programme. Documents, applications, licences, and agreements will require attention. You will also spend money on a phone, laptop, vehicle, or other communication and travel-related equipment.

horoscopes.title: Libra Weekly Horoscope Starting September 20
content: For Libra Sun, Moon and rising signs, Mars is moving through the last degrees of Cancer, so career matters will keep you busy this week. Since Mars is debilitated, you will have some issues at work. You will have to take responsibilities of the tasks, but these tasks will be complicated. Job seekers will follow up on applications or attend interviews. Sine Mars is in the tenth house, those who work in admin, army and sports will have complex work. This transit will make you a bit aggressive, but you should control that, otherwise there will be arguments with your managers.

The Sun will enter your sign, which is also its debilitation sign, so matters concerning you personally will become important. You will take decisions regarding your work, appearance, daily schedule, and plans for the coming weeks. Some of you will change your hairstyle, wardrobe, or general appearance. There will be more meetings and situations where you have to represent yourself directly. You will also take the lead in matters that have been waiting for someone else’s approval. The Sun is weak in Libra, so disagreements can arise when other people question your decisions or expect you to adjust your plans according to their requirements.

Mercury will enter Scorpio, where Venus is already placed, so money and family matters will take up a good part of your time. You will discuss salary, savings, household expenses, and upcoming purchases. Some of you will receive payments, commissions, or money connected with additional work. Both the planets are moving through the second house, so the family matters will be prominent. These planets can trigger your spendthrift nature, so make sure you control it. New job opportunities will come up in fulltime or freelance mode as well. The family environment will become very positive than before.

horoscopes.title: Scorpio Weekly Horoscope Starting September 20
content: Your ruling planet, Mars, transits through Cancer, influencing the ninth house associated with long-distance travel and higher education. Individuals may undertake significant journeys, or finalize arrangements for previously planned trips. For those in higher education, this period may involve examinations, admissions processes, applications, or crucial academic choices. Individuals considering overseas studies will focus on necessary documentation and formal procedures. Progress is indicated for matters related to visas, passports, immigration, and legal affairs. Increased interaction with individuals from diverse backgrounds is also anticipated. Furthermore, issues concerning your father may require your attention. Given Mars' debilitated state, travel plans may encounter sudden alterations, and potential disagreements with educators, mentors, or paternal figures could arise.

The Sun will enter Libra, its debilitation sign, and expenses will start increasing. Travel, medical needs, family commitments, and old payments will take money out of your hands. A hospital visit can come up for you or someone in the family. Some of you will spend on medicines, tests, or treatment. Foreign matters will become active too. If you are waiting for an overseas job, visa, immigration update, or communication from a foreign company, there will be further developments. Work done away from the public eye will also increase.

Mercury and Venus are in your sign, so this is a very important transit for your personal life and health. Since both the planets are the natural charmers, you will have an aura, and people will naturally get attracted towards you. This is the time of personal refinement, so you will buy new clothes and accessories. There will be invitations to functions, meetings, or get-togethers, and you will reconnect with people you have not seen recently. Singles will have chances to meet someone new. You will also receive calls and messages regarding work, business, or personal matters.

horoscopes.title: Sagittarius Weekly Horoscope Starting September 20
content: For Sagittarius Sun, Moon and rising signs, Mars is moving through the last degrees of Cancer, so joint finances will need attention. There will be discussions about loans, taxes, insurance, inheritance, or money shared with your spouse. Some of you will make a loan repayment or deal with pending financial paperwork. Your partner’s income or expenses can change, and this will require some adjustment in the household budget. There will some complex procedures about tax, PF and insurance too. Mars is debilitated in the eighth house, so sudden expenses are possible. Since the eight house indicates healing, many of you will opt for various healing practices.

The Sun will enter Libra, its debilitation sign, and the eleventh house will bring income and professional connections into focus. A pending payment, salary revision, incentive, commission, or business income can come up for discussion. You will meet friends and professional contacts more often, and some of these meetings will be connected with work. Team projects will require your involvement. Those running a business will look for new customers and opportunities through their network. An old friend can contact you again. The Sun will also be debilitation, so there will be arguments between the friends.

The twelfth house of isolation and detachment will be triggered by Mercury and Venus. You will have a strong wanderlust, or you will try to get detached. Those working with foreign companies will have more calls, emails, and meetings with people abroad. Visa, immigration, and overseas job matters can bring further communication. You will spend money on travel, hotels, shopping, medical needs, or personal comforts. Some expenses will happen quietly without the family being involved in every decision. Hospital visits or medical appointments can also come up.

horoscopes.title: Capricorn Weekly Horoscope Starting September 20
content: For Capricorn Sun, Moon and rising signs, Mars is moving through the last degrees of Cancer, and marriage and partnerships will need attention. Your spouse can have a busy week, and some of their matters will naturally become your responsibility too. There can be discussions about money, children, travel, family commitments, or a decision both of you have been postponing. Those planning to marry can take the next step with their families. Business partnerships will also see more activity, especially around clients, payments, and division of work. Since Mars is debilitated in the seventh house, small disagreements can quickly turn into arguments. An old issue between you and your partner can also return for another discussion.

The Sun will move into Libra, and work will become demanding. A manager can ask you to handle something outside your usual responsibilities, or you can temporarily take over another person’s work. Meetings with senior people will increase. There can be changes in the team, reporting manager, project, or working schedule. If you have been waiting for an interview result, promotion discussion, transfer, or internal change, there can be further movement. Business owners will have to deal with an important customer or project personally. Since the Sun is debilitated here, dealing with bosses will not always be easy, and differences over decisions or deadlines can come up.

Mercury will enter Scorpio, where Venus is already placed, so there will be more movement around income and your circle of friends. Pending salary, incentives, commissions, freelance payments, or business dues can come in. Both Mercury and Venus are natural benefics, so there will be some progressive discussions. You will be meeting with new people, who will give you good contacts. Professional contacts will be useful for finding customers, projects, or job openings. Team activities will increase as well.

horoscopes.title: Aquarius Weekly Horoscope Starting September 20
content: For Aquarius Sun, Moon and rising signs, Mars is moving through the last degrees of Cancer, so your workdays can become quite packed. This is a complex transit for work, as Mars is debilitated, so you need rework and hard work. If someone in your team is absent, you can end up handling part of their work as well. Those searching for a job will send applications, attend interviews, or hear from an employer. Loans, EMIs, bills, and money you owe will also need to be sorted out. Since Mars is debilitated in the sixth house, arguments with colleagues are possible. A health issue can also take you to a doctor, pharmacy, or diagnostic centre.

The Sun will move into Libra, and there can be a long journey or some serious planning for one. The debilitated Sun will bring some blocks in the travel so, you need to cross check the travel plans. Students applying to universities will have forms, interviews, examinations, or admission procedures to complete. Those hoping to study or work abroad can receive an update. Legal matters can bring another round of paperwork or discussion. Your father can need your help with something important. Debilitated Sun will surely bring issues with your elders, so you need to be careful.

Your workplace will be again activated with Mercury and Venus, so get ready to take up new tasks. There will be a lot of communications and meetings, so this will be an active week. A manager can call you in to discuss a new assignment or changes in your present role. Some of you will update your résumé and start talking to recruiters. An interview or offer discussion can also come up, so you need to be prepared for these. New job can come up, but make sure you understand the offer clearly. This is a very good transit for those who work in documentation, beauty, fashion and admin.

horoscopes.title: Pisces Weekly Horoscope Starting September 20
content: For Pisces Sun, Moon and rising signs, Mars is moving through the last degrees of Cancer, so children and their matters will keep you busy. There can be admissions, examinations, competitions, sports, or other activities that need your involvement. Mars is debilitation, so the child related matters will need more attention. There are chances for arguments in the relationships. Some of you will start seeing someone new. Debilitation Mars is not good for risky projects, so don’t take risk in the high investments. Speculative investments can also show sudden movement.

The Sun will enter Libra, its debilitation sign, and money shared with others will become important. You can have discussions about loans, taxes, insurance, inheritance, or your spouse’s finances. A repayment can become due, or you can decide to close or restructure an existing loan. There can also be paperwork connected with insurance claims, settlements, pension, gratuity, or family assets. Your partner can have a change in income or an unexpected expense, which can affect the household budget. Some of you will deal with wills, nominations, property shares, or inheritance documents. This is a very transformative period for your finances and emotional needs.

Mercury will enter Scorpio, where Venus is already placed, bringing travel and higher studies into focus. A long-distance journey can be planned, booked, or finally confirmed. Those applying for higher education will be busy with applications, interviews, admissions, or course selection. Students hoping to study abroad can receive communication from universities or institutions. Visa, passport, and immigration matters will also bring paperwork and follow-ups. Some of you will travel for work, education, or a family function. There can be good news from someone living abroad. Teachers, mentors, publishers, and legal professionals will also play a bigger part in your activities during this period.
